description: Dancers step sideways one place along the set to meet a new couple.

walkthrough.line: Look on your {direction} diagonal and identify your new neighbors. Slide {direction} one place along the set until you are across from them.
walkthrough.teach: Look on your {direction} diagonal and identify your new neighbors. Slide {direction} one place along the set until you are across from them. Stay square to the couple across the set and to the dancer beside you, take a step sideways along your own line, and glance the way you are going.
